text: I'd argue it's largely a matter of lifestyle. In a metropolis, people commute long distances, work irregular hours and move house frequently, so there's little opportunity to build lasting relationships. Add to that the rise of digital communication, which lets us maintain friendships with people far away while neglecting those next door. Ironically, we've never been more connected, yet loneliness seems to be on the rise in urban areas.

tips.en: 'Add to that' adds an argument without repeating 'also'.
tips.kk: «Add to that» «also» сөзін қайталамай, дәлел қосады.
tips.ru: «Add to that» добавляет аргумент, не повторяя «also».
tips.example: Add to that the rise of digital communication

tips.en: The ironic ending highlights a paradox and is memorable.
tips.kk: Соңындағы ирония парадоксты көрсетіп, есте қалады.
tips.ru: Ирония в финале подчёркивает парадокс и запоминается.
tips.example: Ironically, we've never been more connected, yet loneliness seems to be on the rise in urban areas

note.en: caused by the way people live

questions.question: Why do you think people in big cities often feel disconnected from their neighbours?

text: I wouldn't say obliged, but I do think there's a moral case for it. Progressive taxation already does this to some extent, ensuring that those who earn more contribute more to public services. Beyond that, philanthropy tends to work best when it's voluntary, because people give more thoughtfully. The risk of compulsion is that it breeds resentment. Ultimately, a fair society needs both a decent safety net and a culture of generosity.

tips.en: A fine distinction between 'obliged' and 'morally right' shows a mature stance.
tips.kk: «Міндетті» мен «адамгершілікті» арасындағы нәзік айырмашылық жетілген ұстанымды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Тонкое различие между «обязаны» и «морально правильно» показывает зрелую позицию.
tips.example: I wouldn't say obliged, but I do think there's a moral case for it

tips.en: Naming a risk and its consequence is a strong argument.
tips.kk: Қауіп пен оның салдары аталған — күшті дәлел.
tips.ru: Назван риск и его последствие — сильный аргумент.
tips.example: The risk of compulsion is that it breeds resentment

text: Quite significantly, I'd say, though perhaps not in the way people assume. The media rarely tells us what to think, but it's remarkably effective at shaping what we think about, by deciding which stories get attention. Social media has complicated matters, since algorithms feed us content that confirms our existing views. As a result, people can end up in echo chambers, which makes constructive debate considerably harder.

tips.en: The distinction between what to think and what to think about shows analysis.
tips.kk: «Не ойлау» мен «неге ойлау» арасындағы айырмашылық талдампаздықты көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Тонкое различие «что думать» и «о чём думать» показывает аналитичность.
tips.example: The media rarely tells us what to think, but it's remarkably effective at shaping what we think about

tips.en: 'As a result' completes the chain of logical steps.
tips.ru: «As a result» завершает цепочку логических шагов.
tips.example: As a result, people can end up in echo chambers

note.en: places where you hear only your own views

questions.question: To what extent does the media influence public opinion?

text: I think it'll put considerable pressure on healthcare and pension systems, as fewer working-age people will be supporting more retirees. Governments will probably have to raise the retirement age or encourage immigration to fill the gap. On a more positive note, older people have a wealth of experience, and if workplaces become more age-inclusive, we could really benefit from that. It's a challenge, but not necessarily a crisis if we plan ahead.

tips.en: Turning to a positive aspect makes the answer balanced.
tips.kk: Оң жағына өту жауапты теңгерімді етеді.
tips.ru: Переход к позитивному аспекту делает ответ сбалансированным.
tips.example: On a more positive note, older people have a wealth of experience

tips.en: A conditional with mixed forms raises Grammatical Range.
tips.kk: Аралас түрлі шартты сөйлем Grammatical Range-ді арттырады.
tips.ru: Условное предложение со смешанными формами повышает Grammatical Range.
tips.example: if workplaces become more age-inclusive, we could really benefit from that
